query: Summarise the latest AI news and also write me a SQL query
summary:
Recent developments in artificial intelligence (AI) highlight significant advancements in both practical applications and the evolving landscape of AI technologies. One notable announcement is from Perplexity, which has launched "teammates," AI agents designed to manage complex, ongoing work across various sectors such as operations and marketing. These agents are built to coordinate projects, adapt to changing priorities, and provide users with the ability to guide their work, enhancing productivity in professional environments [Perplexity launches AI agents for work].

In another significant move, ClickHouse has acquired Xata, aiming to integrate agentic capabilities into its Managed Postgres platform. This collaboration is set to enhance database provisioning and performance, catering to modern applications and AI agents. The acquisition promises to maintain continuity for existing Xata customers while gradually transitioning them to the ClickHouse platform, which will feature advanced functionalities like instant copy-on-write branching [ClickHouse Acquires Xata].

Additionally, there is a growing trend of removing restrictions from AI models, as seen with the emergence of companies like Abliteration AI. This company is focused on making powerful AI models more accessible by eliminating built-in safeguards, a move that has sparked discussions about the implications for safety and ethical use in AI applications [Tear Down Those Guardrails! Meet the Renegades Freeing Chatbots From Corporate Enslavers]. 

Overall, these developments reflect a dynamic and rapidly evolving AI landscape, with innovations aimed at enhancing productivity, performance, and accessibility, while also raising important questions about safety and ethical considerations in AI deployment.

article_hits.title: ClickHouse Acquires Xata
article_hits.content: Back to Blog Xata is joining ClickHouse By: Monica Sarbu Published: Nov 9, 2026 Reading time: 6 min read Today, we're excited to announce that Xata is joining ClickHouse to bring agentic capabilities to ClickHouse Managed Postgres . Together with ClickHouse, we're building a Postgres platform designed for modern applications and AI agents, combining high-performance production workloads on local NVMe storage with Xata’s technology for instant database provisioning, instant copy-on-write branching, and scale-to-zero compute. Nothing changes for Xata customers in the short term and we continue to accept new sign-ups. In parallel, we're working on bringing branching and an agentic tier to ClickHouse Managed Postgres. We will eventually migrate Xata customers to ClickHouse Managed Postgres. You can also read ClickHouse's announcement .
